descriptionChirho: The cardinal numeral שְׁמֹנִים meaning 'eighty,' used in census counts, ages, measurements, and chronological reckonings throughout the Hebrew Bible. All three clusters represent the same numeral in different prepositional environments: bare or with conjunction (S142061, 36x: eng 'eighty/and eighty', spa 'ochenta/y ochenta', hin अस्सी/और अस्सी, arb ثَمَانِينَ/وَثَمَانِينَ, kor 팔십, swa 'themanini/na themanini'), with ב for price or exchange (S142063, 1x: eng 'for eighty', spa 'por ochenta', arb بِثَمانينَ, swa 'kwa shekeli themanini'), and with ב for temporal location (S142064, 1x: eng 'in eighty', spa 'en ochenta', arb فِي ثَمَانِينَ). These are purely grammatical variations of a single cardinal number.
